notes.title: Patch Note (03.30)
notes.content:
Note

- All chapters can now be played regardless of whether the previous chapter is cleared or not.

Game Text
- Fixed Korean grammar error

Game Logic
- Fixed a bug about 'Fishing Net' hostpot in Shoreside Village
- Fixed a bug that tombstones were marked as 'Statue'
- Fixed a bug about the leftmost statue in the graveyard scene

UI
- Showing cursor in Credit
- Display character names to match the dialogue language in Dialogue Log
- Display the most recent speech line first in Dialogue Log

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
- Fixed some translation issues.
- Fixed minor bugs.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement & Roadmap(Edit)
notes.content:
Hello, everyone.

<Unfolded: Camellia Tales> will be released on March 24, 2021.

We'd like to share future plans with the release date announcement.

---

- Launch Schedule

March 24, 2021 - Main game release, digital OST, digital art book release

May 2021 - Free DLC (Chapter 4)

The second half of 2021 - Full-release Nintendo Switch with DLC

---

For more information on <Unfolded: Camellia Tales>, visit our website. 

https://cosdots.com

See you next time.
